The video is captured in a modern social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is bright, natural morning light, featuring crisp whites and lifted shadows to create an airy atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by neutrals (#FFFFFF, #F0E6D3) with a vibrant pop of coral (#D4536D).

[Shot 1] The video begins with the starting frame from <Image 1>, a close-up of <Subject 2> holding a coral-colored cardboard box over a white marble bathroom sink. The background shows clean white subway tiles and a soft-focus window area. The camera is static.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, the shot cuts to a quick, tactile handheld drift as <Subject 2> uses their thumbnail to tear open the top of the cardboard box. The sound of crisp cardboard tearing is sharp and clear. <Subject 1>'s hands reach into the frame, revealing <Subject 3> inside. 

[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, the camera performs a slight push-in on <Subject 3> as <Subject 1> turns the lipstick tube in their palm. A clean stripe of window light catches the satin finish of the tube, highlighting its smooth texture and the rich coral color. The movement is fluid and organic, emphasizing the premium material quality of the product.

The audio consists of the soft, ambient room tone of a bathroom, the distinct, tactile sound of cardboard tearing, and the subtle slide of the lipstick tube being handled.
